caption:
Thank you first. Sorry second

She was ten minutes late. The first thing she said was thank you, not sorry.

Thanking someone for waiting tells them their time mattered, and it opens the visit warmer than an apology does.

For whoever says thanks for waiting before sorry.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes waits on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes rushes in from the left and a bubble says thanks for waiting! The blue one opens its eyes wide and turns happy, and a bubble says of course! The black one's eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me opening with sorry I'm late, to: said thanks for waiting. they smiled.
